summary.result: The study result showed that the process making 3D canal model tried in this study is very useful to generate computer graphic model with the designed canal on the surface of DEM.
summary.background: The canal connects from Keumkang to Mangyungkang in order to supply fresh water into Saemankeum lake.
summary.method: Besides, the present study developed data set in GIS for geogrphical surface modeling as well as parameters in hydraulic analysis for water surface profile on the canal using HEC-RAS model.
